findings.evidence: paper.tex:122 omits the floor; source_evidence/selected/src/program.py:177 applies it during prediction, and source_evidence/selected/src/program.py:194 applies it during calibration; the prediction path calls this correction at source_evidence/selected/src/program.py:315.
findings.fix: Change the manuscript equation to (sum w)^2/max(sum(w^2),1e-12), disclose the denominator floor, and qualify the concentration-only interpretation when that floor is active.
findings.issue: The implementation floors the denominator at 1e-12. This changes shrinkage when squared weights sum below that floor, even when total weight exceeds the separately disclosed cutoff.

summary: Retained results and qualification are supported, but the residual-shrinkage equation does not match the evaluated implementation.
